definitions.title: Family Advocacy Outreach Network Membership Application

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Family Advocacy Outreach Network Membership Application

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro Copy
fields.value: Apply to join FAON so NCMEC can connect families with counseling services and professional support.

fields.name: submissionMode
fields.label: Submission Mode
fields.description: Backend uses the Submit Endpoint URL. Jotform posts to the original Jotform endpoint in a hidden iframe.

fields.name: formAction
fields.label: Submit Endpoint URL
fields.description: Use http://127.0.0.1:8787/faon-application for local mock testing. Replace with the backend endpoint when ready.

fields.name: jotformAction
fields.label: Jotform Submit URL
fields.description: Used only when Submission Mode is Jotform.

fields.name: successMessage
fields.label: Success Message
fields.value: Thank you. Your FAON membership application has been submitted.

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.label: Error Message
fields.value: We could not submit your application. Please try again.

fields.name: topPadding
fields.label: Top Padding (Optional)
fields.description: Accepts CSS lengths like 64px, 4rem, or 0. Plain numbers default to px.
